segment.source: Excuse me, $(#sir/ma'am), but I'm going to have to ask you to leave.<end>
segment.target: Excuse me, $(#sir/ma'am), but I'm going to have to ask you to leave.<end>

segment.source:
::The young woman meets your approach with a chalk-white smile and a polite greeting.::
Greetings, $(#sir/ma'am), and welcome to Coretech. How may I help you?<end>
segment.target:
::The young woman meets your approach with a chalk-white smile and a polite greeting.::
Greetings, $(#sir/ma'am), and welcome to Coretech. How may I help you?<end>

segment.source: <end>
segment.target: <end>

segment.source: I'm looking for work. Do you have anything available?<end>
segment.target: I'm looking for work. Do you have anything available?<end>

segment.source: Most certainly, $(#sir/ma'am). Coretech is the top technology research and application company in Underrail. We have several open positions in the fields of geophysics, chemistry and ballistics. Could you please specify your qualifications so that we may proceed?<end>
segment.target: Most certainly, $(#sir/ma'am). Coretech is the top technology research and application company in Underrail. We have several open positions in the fields of geophysics, chemistry and ballistics. Could you please specify your qualifications so that we may proceed?<end>

segment.source: ::[Electronics]:: How about a different branch of physics? I'm good with electronics. Will that do?<end>
segment.target: ::[Electronics]:: How about a different branch of physics? I'm good with electronics. Will that do?<end>

segment.source: I'm afraid not. As I said, we are in need of someone who is an expert in geophysics, not electronics. But we might have something else available. <end>
segment.target: I'm afraid not. As I said, we are in need of someone who is an expert in geophysics, not electronics. But we might have something else available. <end>

segment.source: Could you please tell me your full name?<end>
segment.target: Could you please tell me your full name?<end>

segment.source: $(context.player.Name).<end>
segment.target: $(context.player.Name).<end>

segment.source: Allow me to do a quick check on you. ::She starts typing something on the keyboard.::<end>
segment.target: Allow me to do a quick check on you. ::She starts typing something on the keyboard.::<end>

segment.source: ::Soon, she shakes her head and continues.:: It seems that you have already been hired by a different employer. I'm afraid we cannot offer you a job due to our company policy. Still, thank you for applying.<end>
segment.target: ::Soon, she shakes her head and continues.:: It seems that you have already been hired by a different employer. I'm afraid we cannot offer you a job due to our company policy. Still, thank you for applying.<end>

segment.source: Thank you for your time.<end>
segment.target: Thank you for your time.<end>

segment.source: Yeah, well, who cares about your stupid company anyway. Goodbye!<end>
segment.target: Yeah, well, who cares about your stupid company anyway. Goodbye!<end>

segment.source:
Hmm, I see. You seem to be in luck, $(#sir/ma'am). We do have a position available. Please, if you'd like, talk to Mister Joseph Harlan. He's in the office right next to this one, down the hallway, first door to the left.
Oh, and before you go: I also need to inform you that the upper floor is off limits to all nonemployees. Thank you.<end>
segment.target:
Hmm, I see. You seem to be in luck, $(#sir/ma'am). We do have a position available. Please, if you'd like, talk to Mister Joseph Harlan. He's in the office right next to this one, down the hallway, first door to the left.
Oh, and before you go: I also need to inform you that the upper floor is off limits to all nonemployees. Thank you.<end>

segment.source: Thank you, I'll go see him.<end>
segment.target: Thank you, I'll go see him.<end>

segment.source: I had some other questions.<end>
segment.target: I had some other questions.<end>

segment.source: Feel free to ask me anything.<end>
segment.target: Feel free to ask me anything.<end>

segment.source: I'm sorry, but this isn't for me. Can we discuss something else?<end>
segment.target: I'm sorry, but this isn't for me. Can we discuss something else?<end>

segment.source: ::[Chemistry]:: I'm a self-taught chemist.<end>
segment.target: ::[Chemistry]:: I'm a self-taught chemist.<end>

segment.source: We are in need of someone who is an *expert* in organic chemistry. But we might have something else available. <end>
segment.target: We are in need of someone who is an *expert* in organic chemistry. But we might have something else available. <end>

segment.source: ::[Guns]:: If by "ballistics" you mean someone that can shoot a gun, then I'm your $(#man/woman)!<end>
segment.target: ::[Guns]:: If by "ballistics" you mean someone that can shoot a gun, then I'm your $(#man/woman)!<end>

segment.source: Well, I'm afraid not. We are in need of a ballistics *expert*. But we might have something else available. <end>
segment.target: Well, I'm afraid not. We are in need of a ballistics *expert*. But we might have something else available. <end>

segment.source: ::[Heavy Guns]:: I shoot big guns. Really big guns.<end>
segment.target: ::[Heavy Guns]:: I shoot big guns. Really big guns.<end>

segment.source: That's very good, but we're not in need of... that at the moment. But we might have something else available. <end>
segment.target: That's very good, but we're not in need of... that at the moment. But we might have something else available. <end>

segment.source: ::[Crossbows]:: As a proficient crossbow user, I think I know a thing or two about ballistics.<end>
segment.target: ::[Crossbows]:: As a proficient crossbow user, I think I know a thing or two about ballistics.<end>

segment.source: ::[Tailoring]:: How about a tailor? I can design and make you wonderful lab coats or security uniforms. Imagine: $(context.player.Name)'s Coreware - clothing of the future, today.<end>
segment.target: ::[Tailoring]:: How about a tailor? I can design and make you wonderful lab coats or security uniforms. Imagine: $(context.player.Name)'s Coreware - clothing of the future, today.<end>

segment.source:
::Her response comes after a slight delay.::
Ehm... We don't have an open position for that. But we might have something else available. <end>
segment.target:
::Her response comes after a slight delay.::
Ehm... We don't have an open position for that. But we might have something else available. <end>

segment.source: ::[Mechanics]:: I suppose you aren't looking for a mechanical engineer or anything similar?<end>
segment.target: ::[Mechanics]:: I suppose you aren't looking for a mechanical engineer or anything similar?<end>

segment.source: I'm afraid not. Not at the moment, at least. But we might have something else available. <end>
segment.target: I'm afraid not. Not at the moment, at least. But we might have something else available. <end>

segment.source: ::[Biology]:: You don't work with living creatures much, do you?<end>
segment.target: ::[Biology]:: You don't work with living creatures much, do you?<end>

segment.source: If by that you mean: "Do we have an open position for a biologist?", then the answer is no, I'm afraid. But we might have something else available. <end>
segment.target: If by that you mean: "Do we have an open position for a biologist?", then the answer is no, I'm afraid. But we might have something else available. <end>

segment.source: ::[Hacking]:: Need someone who's good with computers?<end>
segment.target: ::[Hacking]:: Need someone who's good with computers?<end>

segment.source: Yes, qualifications. Is there any other kind of work I could do here?<end>
segment.target: Yes, qualifications. Is there any other kind of work I could do here?<end>

segment.source: Well, we might have something available. <end>
segment.target: Well, we might have something available. <end>

segment.source: I don't think I have the right qualifications. I've got other questions for you, though.<end>
segment.target: I don't think I have the right qualifications. I've got other questions for you, though.<end>

segment.source: What can you tell me about Coretech?<end>
segment.target: What can you tell me about Coretech?<end>

segment.source: Coretech is the primary technology research, manufacturing and application company in Core City. Being a successor to the great Biocorp, Coretech employs some of the brightest minds in solving difficult problems of today.<end>
segment.target: Coretech is the primary technology research, manufacturing and application company in Core City. Being a successor to the great Biocorp, Coretech employs some of the brightest minds in solving difficult problems of today.<end>

segment.source: Coretech's desire to create a better future for everyone through technological advancement remains unmatched.<end>
segment.target: Coretech's desire to create a better future for everyone through technological advancement remains unmatched.<end>

segment.source: I'll be going now.<end>
segment.target: I'll be going now.<end>

segment.source: Welcome back, $(#sir/ma'am). How may I help you?<end>
segment.target: Welcome back, $(#sir/ma'am). How may I help you?<end>
